extensions:
  support-this:

    platforms:

filters: [support-this]
---

With `display: icon-username`, each link shows the platform's icon and the account, without the platform's name. It is more compact than the default and works well when readers know the platforms by their logos.

## Configuration

```yaml
extensions:
  support-this:
    display: icon-username
    description: "Thank you for considering supporting this work!"
    platforms:
      github: coatless
      patreon: coatless
      ko_fi: coatless
      buy_me_a_coffee: coatless
filters: [support-this]
```

## Other formats

In RevealJS, Typst, and Word, the icon is a symbol for the platform. PDF output leaves out the symbols, which LaTeX's default fonts can't display, and shows the platform's name in their place.

The other display modes are [Icon, Platform & Username](qsupport-this-display-icon-platform-username.qmd), [Text](qsupport-this-display-text.qmd), and [Badges](qsupport-this-display-badge.qmd).
